summary: Customer evidence request: ordered activity slice with per-event authorization assertions and delivery-count mismatch
description:
Issue summary:
Novus Bank requests a signed, chronologically ordered activity slice covering 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z through 2026-03-01T12:00:00Z that includes per-event authorization assertions (role, token_id, auth_method) for compliance review. They report exported slice counts do not match counts reported in Redwood Console for the same interval (Console: 18,472 events; export manifest: 17,995 events). Customer needs this for a regulatory submission and requests HMAC-signed manifest and a short reconciliation report.

Impact:
- Customer compliance team cannot complete evidence packet for regulator until counts reconcile and auth assertions are present on each event.
- Request is time-sensitive (regulatory deadline).

Environment:
- Production export job (tenant: novus-bank-prod) exporting NDJSON batches to customer S3 bucket (us-east-1).
- Export configuration: hourly deltas, resume tokens, per-batch HMAC (sha256), timezone: UTC.

Request details / desired deliverables:
1) Re-run or provide a reconstituted ordered activity slice for 2026-03-01 00:00:00Z - 12:00:00Z with non-overlapping records and ordered by event_timestamp.
2) Include an additional field auth_context.role, auth_context.token_id, auth_context.method on each event (pseudonymized token_id acceptable if tied to provided mapping).
3) Provide an HMAC-signed manifest listing batch file names, per-file counts, and cumulative checksum; signature to be verifiable by the customer's security team.
4) Short reconciliation report explaining count discrepancy and any remediation steps taken.

Steps to reproduce (how customer observed mismatch):
steps_to_reproduce: Customer queried Console dashboard -> Activity -> Time window 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z to 2026-03-01T12:00:00Z and exported count (18,472).
Customer downloaded last export batch set from S3 (manifest attached) and summed per-file counts (17,995).
Customer scanned exported NDJSON for events missing auth_context fields in expected schema.
Customer opened ticket after failing to reconcile counts using resume tokens in manifest.
expected_behavior: Exported per-batch counts should sum to the same total reported in Console for the same UTC time window. Each event should include auth_context.* fields when tenant has requested auth assertions in onboarding configuration.
actual_behavior: Export manifest sum is 477 events short of Console. A subset of exported events lacks auth_context fields. Resume token sequencing appears to include an overlapping batch (duplicate event UUIDs observed) and one missing batch for 2026-03-01T05:00:00Z - 06:00:00Z in the export manifest.
logs: Console summary screenshot (customer provided) attached to ticket
Preliminary server-side export job logs: export-job-id=ej-20260301-17a2 (link: https://logs.redwood.internal/ej-20260301-17a2)
investigation_notes:
Initial triage (Support): pulled export manifest and compared Console counts. Observed missing batch entry for 05:00-06:00UTC. Cross-referenced export-job logs: one worker failed to upload batch 05:00 due to transient 403 when writing to customer S3 bucket; worker retried and created a partial file with suffix '.partial' which was not included in the signed manifest generation step. Hypothesis: partial file was excluded from final manifest, leading to missing records. Also confirmed some legacy export schema did not include auth_context by default for tenants onboarded before 2025-11; customer requested auth assertions in a later onboarding note but the export config was not fully reconciled.
SRE notes: there are duplicated UUIDs across two consecutive batches (04:00-05:00 and 05:00-06:00) indicating an overlap during retry. Resume token generation logic skipped inclusion of '.partial' file, causing manifest to exclude repaired/merged file.
Recommended immediate actions: generate a consolidated re-run for the window that merges partial/duplicate batches, include auth_context enrichment pass, and produce a signed manifest. Also propose short-term workaround: provide per-event patch file with missing auth_context for affected event UUIDs.
workaround_proposal: 1) Provide a targeted 'patch' NDJSON with the 477 missing events including auth_context fields and a small reconciliation CSV mapping event_uuid -> source_file. 2) If customer prefers a full slice, schedule a one-time reconstituted export for the 00:00-12:00 UTC window with sequential ordering and a new manifest signed by Redwood's HMAC key.
resolution: Pending - Support created a remediation plan and requires customer signoff for two items: (A) acceptance of per-event pseudonymized token_id mapping method, (B) permission to access and re-upload merged batch into customer's S3 staging area under a customer-provided ephemeral role. Once customer approves, SRE will run reconstitution job and produce HMAC-signed manifest.
next_steps: Support to send formal approval checklist and minimal legal addendum for temporary write-access to customer's staging bucket (if customer opts for re-upload).
SRE to prepare reconstitution job runbook and estimate (ETA 6 business hours after approval).
If customer rejects write-access, Support will prepare patch NDJSON + reconciliation CSV for manual ingestion by customer security team (ETA 3 business hours).
comments: 2026-03-10 14:12 - Aisha Patel (Support): Opened ticket with initial customer-provided manifest and screenshots. Asked for S3 bucket read ACL details and confirmation of requested auth fields.

2026-03-10 15:05 - Marco Rossi (SRE): Found partial upload and retry overlap in export-job ej-20260301-17a2. Suggest reconstitution. Noted tenant pre-2025-11 onboarding may require explicit auth enrichment flag.

2026-03-10 16:40 - Novus Security (customer): Confirms they requested auth assertions on 2026-02-12 during onboarding; requests minimal exposure of token_id (pseudonymization acceptable) and prefers patch NDJSON rather than re-upload.

2026-03-11 09:20 - Marco Rossi (SRE): Preparing patch NDJSON generator and will deliver mapping CSV with HMAC manifest for the patch set; awaiting customer's final confirmation on pseudonymization approach.
notes_for_legal: Customer requests per-event authorization assertions which may include token identifiers. Discussed pseudonymization option; legal to review addendum for temporary write access and for transfer of pseudonymized token mapping. See linked_confluence for export playbook.
